      (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.microHalf (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n)) (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.blockCount (_root_.ThreeSum.Scales.inputBits n))*(232*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.Scales.mu n+2)*_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.StageBounds.encoderCount n := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
For input length $n$, let $h,J,\mu$ be its actual local size, block count, and total block size, and let $F$ be the explicit catalog-program factor. Then $$\operatorname{catalogWork}(n)\le F(h,J)(232\mu+2)\operatorname{encoderCount}(n).$$
